system.description:
Readied Baggage (Passive): All Readied baggage items must be equipped to RIS to work. When occupying RIS, baggage items create extra RIS within them, often with specific requirements.

Weapon Holster (Passive): This item provides 3 readied item slots (RIS). You can store a single weapon in the weapon holster (even if it would not fill up every slot). You cannot put anything in these slots except for a weapon.

1 Item Slot · 100gc · Readied Baggage, rulebook p.202
